notes.title: Interplanetary Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Planet-sized news everyone![/h1]
Welcome to a whole new world – hoVRplanet. It´s a desert planet, so don´t expect much to be going on there..... though like all good planets it has spherical gravity! I know some of you will enjoy that ;)

Also with the last update the hoVRpark got a big make-over:
[list]
[*] New vegetation, performance-optimized, beautiful autumn colors
[*] Better braking physics
[*] New Sounds
[*] More “Holograffities”
[*] Bugfixes
[/list]

Let me know how you like the changes and boarding on sand. Oh, and please tell me how “interplanetary travelling” or "VR-Planet Hopping" feels for you.

[previewyoutube=-r_3xJd0ZWQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Tomy

notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
sorry, that there was no update for such a long time, but I had a lot of other stuff to do in these strange times. Here is a minor update to improve overall performance and to fix some bugs. Thank you very much to everyone giving me feedback.
I am still having lots of ideas for developing this game further. And hopefully I will find more time to do so again. There will be something coming... soon(ish)...

notes.title: Physics Bugfix / Floating Rocks
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I found a physics mistake I made in an update, which for the last couple of days made the controls stutter a little. It is fixed now and the carving should be smoother now. Sorry, if you had a bad experience.

Speaking of physics... these blue rocks don´t obey gravity anymore. I think it´s because they are filled with energy orbs. 

Have fun! :-)

notes.title: Controls Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
I do my best to fulfill your wishes...

[h1]Smooth Turning[/h1]
[list]
[*] requested by many, now on touchpad press / joystick
[*] Personally I prefer to turn my whole body. That´s the way I developed the game and trained my VR-legs :-) But I understand that some people don´t like it. 
[*] Please let me know if this works for you.
[/list]

[h1]Invert Thrust[/h1]
[list]
[*] Quick Fix: Press "i" on your keyboard during game, if you want to accelerate and boost with your front hand.
[*] I will add a menu solution later
[/list]

[h1]Looping Mode[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some very fearless users requested "upside down". So I experimented with this. My stomach does not like it. So all I can do is warn you:
[*] DON`T PRESS "L" during game! This will activate the looping mode.
[*] Then you can press Touchpad or Joystick up/down, when in air. 
[*] Please let me know, if you survived this :-)
[/list]

[h1]Spectator Camera[/h1]
[list]
[*] If you want to make a video, you might want to use a 3rd Person camera
[*] Press "c" in game
[*] Use the arrow keys to move the cam
[*] Use PgUp / PgDwn to zoom
[*] Show me your stunts! :-)
[/list]

Please let me know, if all of that works for you.
Tomy
